title: Simultaneous 4-Uniform DDT and BCT S-Boxes
summary: Four-uniform DDTs are common among differentially strong S-boxes, but whether an S-box can also attain a four-uniform BCT remains unresolved.

formal_statement.body: Most differentially strong $n$-bit-to-$n$-bit S-boxes are designed to have a 4-uniform DDT, whereas achieving a 4-uniform BCT appears difficult, especially as $n$ increases. Determine whether there exists an $n$-bit-to-$n$-bit S-box whose DDT and BCT are simultaneously 4-uniform, with particular emphasis on the practically common sizes $n\in\{4,8\}$.

scope.domain: Design of S-boxes with joint differential and boomerang uniformity.
parameters: n: the common input and output bit width, with particular interest in 4 and 8 bits
scope.unresolved_remainder: Whether an n-bit-to-n-bit S-box exists whose DDT and BCT are both 4-uniform, especially for n equal to 4 or 8.

citations.label: Boomerang Connectivity Table: A New Cryptanalysis Tool

progress.summary: The paper explicitly asks whether 4-uniform DDT and BCT can be achieved simultaneously. It argues that attaining a 4-uniform BCT becomes difficult as S-box size increases but provides neither a construction nor a nonexistence proof.
citation_labels: Carlos Cid et al., Boomerang Connectivity Table: A New Cryptanalysis Tool
